description: UNDERSTANDING — A VC firm's portfolio companies, each matched to the network and rated. Filter publishes_api=true (companies that actually ship an API — about 37% of any book), in_network=true, band, or min_score; sort by score (default), api_count, or name. The demand-side view of who a fund has backed. Understanding plan. Priced per result — $0.005 per request plus $0.0002 per record returned (less past 100), capped at $0.50 a request, under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. Estimate first at /api/v1/prices/estimate. See apis://prices.

band.description: Rating bands: exemplar, strong, developing, thin, minimal.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

is_provider.description: Only portfolio companies with a provider profile on the network. Nearly every row qualifies (a profile is created for each portfolio company), so this barely narrows anything — use publishes_api instead.

publishes_api.description: Only portfolio companies that publish an API indexed on the network — the real rate is about 37% of a book, not 100%. This is the filter you want for "how much of this fund ships an API".

name: vc_portfolio
